icon.description: Large sweeping weapon with heavy damage and cooldown.

use.title: $$ability$ Power Slam
use.desc:
Launch into the air after <hl>$channel_time$t</hl>, growing your slam radius up to <hl>$radius$m</hl>.
Upon landing deal <dmg>$ability_dmg$ $$ddmg$</dmg> and launch nearby enemies up. Enemies in the center take <dmg>$critical_multiplier$x crit $$ddmg$</dmg>.
Effectiveness halved through blocks.

icon.ability_boost: Launch delay reduced to <hl>$boost_channel_time$t</hl>, max slam radius increased to <hl>$boost_radius$m</hl>, and enemies in the center take <dmg>$boost_critical_multiplier$x crit $$ddmg$</dmg>.
